titulo: Install from the official source and sign in with your account
lead: Installing the program, signing in with your account, and opening it in the folder are three different steps, each with its own check. The command comes from the official page, the account is your subscription, and no password passes through the terminal.
objetivo: install Git, gh, Node, and the agent (Claude Code or Codex) from cmd and confirm the version and sign-in method.
hero_alt: A hand checking the label on a sealed box next to a laptop with the terminal open.

aprende.t: Install Git, GitHub CLI, and Node with winget
Install Claude Code or Codex from the official address
Sign in with your subscription and check the method, without exposing any key

secoes.titulo: From zero to an open agent
secoes.sub: Three steps, each with its own "check."

nos.detalhe: Installing puts the program on your computer. It does not yet connect your account or choose the folder. After installing, close cmd and open it again: only the new window can see the program that just arrived.

nos.sub: Through the browser, never through the terminal

itens.t: Subscription: Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT Plus/Pro

nos.detalhe: Like a badge at a turnstile: the terminal sends you to the browser, and that is where you sign in. Your password never passes through the terminal. Signing in with your account uses your subscription plan; an API key bills by usage, on a different account.

The agent works in the folder where it was opened. The first time in a folder, it asks whether you trust it: this is your practice folder, so confirm. To exit, type /quit in Codex or /exit in Claude Code.

secoes.legenda: Right after installing, opening the agent and seeing a login prompt is not a bug: step 1 worked and step 2 is still missing.

rolagem_fim.texto: Installed? Check the version. Signed in? Check the method. Opened? Check the folder. If something fails, you know exactly which of the three steps it stopped at.

secoes.titulo: Check the seal before opening the box
secoes.sub: Four precautions that apply to any new program.

passos.sub: Read the name inside the command
texto: "Faster" commands are going around the internet. A command pasted without checking can run anything.
Read the sender: Git.Git, GitHub.cli, OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS, @openai/codex, claude.ai/install.cmd. A different name, from an unknown page, is not something you paste.

exemplo.texto: A package with "codex" in the name but without @openai/ in front of it.

texto: Paste one command, wait for it to finish and for the > to come back. You don't need to understand the lines that scroll by.
The first time, winget may ask if you accept the source terms: type Y and press Enter.
Close cmd and open it again. Then git --version, gh --version and claude --version or codex --version answer with a number.
"Is not recognized as an internal or external command" is almost always just the old window.

exemplo.texto: Installed it? Close and reopen cmd before checking.

texto: The first time it opens, the agent asks you to sign in: use your subscription. In Codex, codex login opens the browser and codex login status tells you which way you signed in.
The project sheet records the method ("account" or "API"). The key itself never goes into a sheet, a request or a screenshot.

secoes.sub: Once per computer. Copy one block, wait for it to finish, close and reopen cmd.

blocos.rot: cmd · Git, GitHub CLI and Node
blocos.conteudo:
winget install --id Git.Git -e
winget install --id GitHub.cli -e
winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e

blocos.rot: cmd · the agent (pick one, or both)
blocos.conteudo:
rem Claude Code:
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd

rem Codex:
npm install -g @openai/codex

blocos.rot: cmd · in a NEW window, check
cmd · sign in and check the method (Codex)
cmd · open the agent in the project folder

abas.html:
C:\Users\ana> winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e
Instalado com êxito
C:\Users\ana> rem fechou o cmd e abriu outro
C:\Users\ana> npm install -g @openai/codex
added 1 package in 9s
C:\Users\ana> codex login status
Logged in using ChatGPT

Version numbers and times change over time. What matters is that a number shows up, not the error message.

• "… is not recognized as an internal or external command": close cmd, open it again and repeat.
  • winget asked you to accept terms: Y and Enter.
  • login status shows an API key and you wanted the account: codex logout and then codex login.
  • The agent asks if you trust the folder: it's your practice folder, confirm.

In the Terminal on Mac or Linux, Claude Code installs with curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash and Codex with npm install -g @openai/codex (Node comes first). The check is the same: --version in a new window.

secoes.sub: Notice what happens when you check in the same window.

missoes.saida:
Encontrado Git [Git.Git]
Baixando…
Instalado com êxito
missoes.explica: The --id with -e asks for the exact name, with no guessing. That's the seal.

missoes.pede: Check that Git answers, in this same window.
missoes.saida:
'git' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.
missoes.explica: Expected error: the window opened before the install can't see the new program yet. It's not a defect.

missoes.saida: (window closed · you opened a new cmd)
missoes.explica: In real life: Windows key, cmd, Enter. New window, program visible.
A version number: the computer recognizes the program. Step 1 checked.

missoes.pede: Check which method Codex used to sign in.
missoes.explica: "Connected using ChatGPT": that's the subscription account, not an API key. Write down only that on your sheet.

secoes.fim: Rehearsal done. On your computer, the rule is the same: after installing, close and reopen cmd before checking.
secoes.legenda: Simulation: the real messages may vary with the version of Windows and of the program.

exercicios.texto: Install Git, GitHub CLI and Node with winget, plus the agent you're going to use. Close and reopen cmd and run the --version commands.

exercicios.titulo: E4 · Sign in and write down the method
exercicios.texto: Open the agent, sign in with your subscription through the browser, and write down on a sheet (or a note on your phone) which method is active and where you checked.
exercicios.pronto: the sheet says "account" (or "API") and contains no password or key.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You installed Git and, in the same window, git --version answered "not recognized". What should you do?
opcoes: Install it again with a different command.
Close cmd, open a new one and check again.
perguntas.explica: The window you opened before the installation can't see the new program. A new window fixes it almost every time; reinstalling only makes things more complicated.

perguntas.p: In a group, someone sent a "faster" command to install Codex, with a package name different from @openai/codex. What do you do?
opcoes: Don't paste it; use the command from the official page.
Ask the agent to run it for you.
perguntas.explica: The name inside the command is the seal. A command from an unknown source can run anything on your computer.

perguntas.p: What goes on the project sheet about the agent's access?
opcoes: A screenshot of the login screen.
The API key, so you don't lose it.
The method (account or API) and where you checked.
perguntas.explica: Write down the method, never the credential. A key in text, a screenshot or a request can be used by someone else, and the account is yours.
